desc: Identify dynamic-prefix maintenance: inserting/removing an element changes the answer by its absolute-distance sum against the opposite active multiset.
Implement and sample-validate a two-dimensional Mo-ordering solution with coordinate-compressed Fenwick trees.
Prove the insertion/removal contribution formula, including equal values.
Develop and validate a substantially faster offline/block-decomposition algorithm than 2D Mo with Fenwick trees.
Establish worst-case time and memory bounds for the block-decomposition replacement under `N ≤ 10^5`, `K ≤ 10^4`.
Implement the final stdin/stdout Python solution using the validated block-decomposition and persistent-segment-tree approach.
